# configuration vector axis

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisConfigurationVector`](gmeow-axisConfigurationVector.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisConfigurationVector>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A generic n-dimensional configuration vector axis for variable-DOF robots. The actual dimensionality is pushed to the solver layer via [`CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md).[`matrixShape`](../properties/gmeow-matrixShape.md) ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:axisConfigurationVector`](gmeow-axisConfigurationVector.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md).
